MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

2. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 2

3. Solve for x: x + 6 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 11
   C. 6
   D. 5

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 25
   C. 31
   D. 27

6. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 13
   C. 12
   D. 7

7. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

9. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 82

10. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 17
   C. 73
   D. 1

11. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

12. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 64
   C. 0
   D. 16

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

1. B — 36
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 6 × 6
3. Area = 36
Final Answer: 36 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. A — 48
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 8 × 6
3. Product = 48
Final Answer: 48
